products.title: Keza
products.body_html: Vibrant and winey, Keza brings purple fruit and raisin notes from the highlands of Rwanda. This fully washed experimental Red Bourbon is crafted for bold body and clarity, scoring 87 on the SCA scale.

products.title: Tamu
products.body_html: Bright and excited, Tamu brings citrus, floral, black tea and grape notes from Kenya. Grown at up to 1,550 m to 1,700m and washed for clarity, it’s a clean, expressive cup with an SCA score of 88. Pure flavour, crafted with purpose.

products.title: Ligéro (Decaf)
products.body_html: Smooth, sweet, and full of flavour – this Arabica from Peru brings notes of chocolate, malt, and berry. Grown at high altitudes and fully washed for clarity, it’s a decaf that doesn’t compromise on taste. Sustainably sourced for consistency and quality, all year round, it scores 84 poi

products.title: Fusão
products.body_html: Smooth and comforting, Fusão blends fully washed Honduran and naturally processed Brazilian Arabicas for a rich cup with notes of dark chocolate, malt, nuts, and plum. Roasted medium for balance, it brings together sweetness, body, and a hint of spice. Easy to enjoy – perfect for every

products.title: Aléro
products.body_html: Smooth and mellow, Alero combines chocolate, caramel, and stone fruit notes for a balanced everyday cup. Grown at up to 1,560 m and fully washed, it offers gentle sweetness with a medium roast profile. With an SCA score of 83.5, it’s an easygoing choice with solid quality.

products.title: Amizade
products.body_html: Sweet, smooth, and comforting – Amizade brings together notes of chocolate, nutella, and dried fruit with hints of cinnamon. Grown in the highlands of Minas Gerais and naturally sun-dried, it offers a rich body and mellow acidity. With an SCA score of 83.5, it’s a well-balanced classic
